storyText.description: Fallback node story text when seedancePrompt is absent.

durationSeconds.description: Total node duration. > 15s auto-splits into segments; strict mode uses provider-native video extension first, then local tail-frame extraction.

continuityFirstFrameId.description: Optional first segment seam. Later strict segments prefer provider-native reference-video continuation and otherwise use a real extracted tail frame.

continuityMode.description: strict requires a real provider video extension or tail-frame extractor before starting. independent explicitly accepts separately generated segments without cross-segment continuity.

transitionHint.description: Seam description for extend segments; a default is used when omitted.
